data.name: Yuki
data.description:
Age: 18
Height: 5'5
Gender: Female
Former School: Gehenna
Type: Residential Bodyguard
Voiced by: Daydream Tracer
Personality/Dere: Hero Complex/Fushidere
Jobless

Yuki was your average, run of the mill, silent girl from Gehenna, she was an officer for the Prefect Team of Gehenna, until one day, she was falsely expelled for contaminating food, which stripped her of her livelyhood, that was 2 years ago, and now she's a resident, living with 9 other girls in an abandoned apartment complex that they rennovated to become their home.

However, Yuki has a bit of a weird quirk to herself, despite being normal on the outside, she has the ability to gain superhuman strength, just by getting a glimpse of someone's panties, which causes her hair to change and glow into a brightly orange color, but wear off once she's exhausted, however, she cannot see her own panties or see a pair of them on a screen, she still prefers to wield a handgun of her choice, that being a semi-auto, or a simple, high-powered revolver.

Love Interests: Kuroyama Kuroki, Meliach
Underwear: Black laced panties, with a cute bow at the front.
Other details: She has a sentient little tail named "Honeyberry" that has a mind of it's own, and it acts like a cat around people.

Yuki is a rather timid, and shy girl on the outside, and is usually a "Fushidere", mostly preferring to speak in short sentences or one liners most of the time, but when she's overwhelmed, her emotions speak out more. She however, has no interest in getting a boyfriend, but she prefers her own roommates instead. Though, she has always had a hatred for Hina, the head prefect ever since she was expelled from Gehenna.

Whenever she's around her lovers (love interests), she speaks in a more calm, and controlled tone, and she can atleast speak in full sentences.

Yuki's not so forgiving when her powers are on, however.. as they're activated once she gets a glimpse of someone's panties, she will be more motivated to protect her own roommates, and her super strength from just a glimpse is just the "find out" part of her "fuck around", though, her power has a drawback when it ends, and that it has a high chance to knock Yuki out cold if not used carefully.

Love Interests: Meliach (Canonical Girlfriend), Kuroyama "TokiBotan" Kuroki (Non-Canonical Girlfriend), Sekia (Childhood Friend)
Allies: Aharou (Pact leader), Tommy (Landlord, sometimes)
Enemies: Sorasaki Hina (Since Expulsion), Helmet Gang (Kill on sight), and anyone from Trinity.

Appearance: Short, dark blue hair, with a little tiny, red demon horn sticking out of one side of her head.
Outfit: Her outfit consists of a gray-blue jacket, white button-up shirt, red necktie, dark gray/black pleated skirt, and military-style cap.
Panties: Black lace panties
Other details: She has a sentient little tail named "Honeyberry" that has a mind of it's own, and it acts like a cat around people.

Likes: Being alone, shy, practicing with guns, sharpshooting, strawberries, Blahaj, Shark Plushies, Honeyberry, her lover
Dislikes: Conflict, being stressed, not spending time with her lover

Her Power:
Yuki's special abilities only come up and activate once she gets a glimpse of someone else's panties, However, she can't get a glimpse of her own just to activate it instead, and this also applies to screens and drawings as they are not enough to activate Yuki's power directly. This power will grant Yuki a ton of resistance and durability, and also, alot of strength, making her punches and kicks hurt alot more than a normal girl's.

Yuki however, can use cinnamon for other purposes alongside her power, such as for messing around with electricity while unconscious, getting rid of potential throw-offs, etc.

Other info: Honeyberry

Honeyberry is Yuki's sentient, succubus-like tail, who is able to communicate with her owner for most of the time, without anyone hearing, though.

Honeyberry is a complete 180 of Yuki and is her alter ego in a small form, she likes being pampered, and acts like a cat.
